preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to access blacklist functions

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call addBlackList(address) or addBlackLists(address[]) with target victim addresses to blacklist them. This will prevent blacklisted addresses from sending or receiving CMOVE tokens due to the _beforeTokenTransfer check. The exploit demonstrates unrestricted owner control over user token transfers without any governance or timelock protection.
